title.value: UK Core Observation Vital Signs Body Weight

description.value: Defines the additional constraints and extensions on the UK Core Observation Vital Signs profile, for the recording of the clinical observation of a patients weight

purpose.value: To provide implementers with additional support when implementing weight measuring and to provide a consistent structure to how the data is presented.
